author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Starter layer configuration (Story 3.2): Focus, from starter-recipes.md and design log 2026-10-27 (m). Theta reference: a 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated by the sine envelope at 6 Hz, 75 percent AM depth. Gamma PAC layer: a 250 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at 40 Hz, its AM depth opening to 100 percent for 50 ms bursts centered on the 0 degree coupling phase. No binaural layer. Loops at the 45 min cap, opening 60 s, body 120 s. No ramps or fades (Epic 4). Not the Epic 6 starter recipe.
